evidence: Our findings reveal that both PARPi olaparib and rucaparib sensitize A549 cells to (12)C-ion exposure, with olaparib exhibiting superior sensitization.
Thus we are the first to demonstrate that olaparib sensitizes NSCLC cells to carbon ion by interfering with HR and NHEJ pathway.
Our findings reveal that both PARPi olaparib and rucaparib sensitize A549 cells to (12)C-ion exposure, with olaparib exhibiting superior sensitization.
